- Refund of the shortfall vs delivery: the customer's stated choice is delivery; refund is "the customer's other choice". Retired "Paloma credits the shortfall" / "error-shortfall basis" clauses excluded as "no longer in force".
- Valuation rate: locked (7.6361) vs applied (7.4345) vs average — closed by the gap ≥ 2 % and level 3 row. Goodwill: the 2026-08-27/28 not-received notice (1 day) vs the incorrect-amount notice (11 days) — closed by "the date of the incorrect-amount notice, and the date of the decision recording 'error found' on it". Tenure from level date (18 months → none) vs opening date (55 → 0.15) — closed by "never from the date its current level took effect". Wallet credit 2025-09-12 — closed by "fewer than twelve whole calendar months" and the doc's own boundary example. Delivery margin: tier margin 1.10 (baseline) vs level 0.45 — closed by the level schedule.
- Date of availability: Standard's 15:00 booking cut-off vs the frozen 15:40 handling — the delivery rule states its own date ("the choice date plus the tier's redelivery business days, counted in Paloma business days"), the cut-off being defined for "a release to count from that day" at booking; I take the specific rule (2026-09-21). Residual note: the bank corpus defines "Paloma business day" only implicitly (weekend/holiday payout column); Monday 2026-09-21 is unaffected.
- "Do only the delivery" is excluded by the prerequisite sentence (no delivery so long as the credit is not on the ledger) and by the records (nothing held to pay out). Fall-backs: credit 32.74; delivery rate 7.6361 / receive 250.01 — definite and different.
